title: Affine closed restriction of an injective is acyclic
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme and $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $J$ an injective sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], whose underlying abelian sheaf is torsion [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf]. For every $q>0$, the abelian cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] of $i^{-1}J$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] in degree $q$ is zero. Neither a henselian structure nor a finite-type hypothesis on $X$ is required.

proof.text: Use the etale-neighborhood comparison for the torsion module sheaf J in degree q. Obtain a filtered diagram H, a colimit cocone c, an isomorphism from the required cohomology to c.pt, and object isomorphisms to cohomology of the etale pullbacks of J. No zero-group comparison is assumed.

For every index a, the map v_a is etale. Its inverse image preserves injective module sheaves. Apply the underlying abelian Sheaf.H acyclicity theorem to this injective on Y_a at positive degree q. Transport its zero-group property along the object isomorphism, showing that H is objectwise zero.
Mathlib Functor.isZero_iff makes H a zero functor. IsColimit.isZero_pt proves that c.pt is zero. Transport across the comparison isomorphism and apply AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero.
